comment: I want the software I use to be good quality with easily maintainable, well documented, secure code in the background.  I would like it to use as few third party libraries as possible to minimise the impact of vulnerabilities found in these.  I'm not going to tell you how much you should be using AI - I leave it to your judgement whilst ideally working towards these ideals.  I use Proton's AI offering at home (Lumo) as it is private and secure.  If you develop a connector/MCP which one day can optionally be used to interact with Buckets then I may be interested to play with that in the future.
name: Matthew
